operating_notes.text: The Group operates a single reportable segment, pharmaceuticals, per Ind AS 108.
Six subsidiaries were not audited by Deloitte; they contributed total revenue of ₹35.76 Cr and a net loss after tax of ₹0.13 Cr for FY26.
IQVIA puts the 2025 EU market for Dabigatran Etexilate at about USD 392.84 million, with Italy at USD 60.91 million.
Kalmeshwar plant underwent EU GMP re-inspection by German and Portuguese authorities from May 4 to May 7, 2026.
Promoter Dr. Anwar Daud's holding rises to 25.05% from 24.90% after a proposed 80,000-share inter-se purchase from promoter Mr. Zulfiquar Kamal.
TGA GMP certificate covers non-sterile finished products at the Kalmeshwar plant: hard capsules, tablets, granules, powders for suspension, wafers and soluble films.

timeline.summary: Zulfiquar Kamal, Promoter of ZIM Laboratories Limited, declared no encumbrance of shares by him or Persons Acting in Concert for FY2025-26 under SEBI Regulation 31(4).
Zim Laboratories' Nagpur plant underwent an EU GMP inspection by German and Portuguese authorities.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹105.27 Cr (-3.2% YoY), net profit ₹3.74 Cr (-23.4% YoY).
2026-05-19: AIFA granted Marketing Authorisation in Italy for Dabigatran Etexilate (75/110/150 mg) capsules to wholly owned subsidiary SIA ZIM Laboratories Limited, Latvia.
Zim Laboratories reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹105.3 Cr (-3.2% YoY) and announced a ₹35 Cr preferential share issue to Florintree Trinex LLP.
Zim Laboratories Limited shared Q4 & FY26 earnings conference call recording on its website on 20.05.2026.
2026-06-04: Promoter Dr. Anwar Daud disclosed a proposed off-market inter-se purchase of 80,000 shares (0.15%) from promoter Mr. Zulfiquar Kamal, exempt under SAST Regulation 10(1)(a)(ii).
16 Oct 2026: Zim Laboratories received a TGA GMP Certificate of Compliance, issued 15 October 2026, for its Kalmeshwar, Nagpur plant, valid to 21 June 2028.
